listenings.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. This is an announcement for passengers on the flight to Miami, departing from gate twenty-two. The aircraft is arriving late from Lisbon, so the new departure time is twenty past seven. That is ninety minutes later than the time printed on your boarding pass. Passengers with a connection in Miami should go to the transfer desk directly in front of gate twenty-two, where our staff will rebook you on the next available flight. There is no need to queue at the main desk. While you are waiting, the airline is going to give every passenger a voucher for food and drink at any of the restaurants after security. Please keep watching the screens, because we will announce boarding as soon as the aircraft is ready.

Hi, it is me, calling about next week. I am going to arrive on Wednesday at about half past ten in the morning, so I should be at the office before lunch. The schedule is tight: I have three meetings on Wednesday and I fly back on Thursday night. Two things. First, if the car is not there when I land, do not worry about it, I will take a taxi and send you the receipt. Second, if anything moves in the schedule, call me straight away, because I will be able to change the Thursday meeting but not the Wednesday ones. That is everything. See you on Wednesday.

extra_audio.text: Sarah asks Janderson for his passport and his boarding pass. He says he is going to fly to Miami and that he has a connection to New York. Sarah tells him the flight is going to take off about ninety minutes late. He answers that he is going to miss his connection and asks what his options are. Sarah says she will put him on the later flight and print a new boarding pass.
